name: Long-Term Solutions
summary: At the Magram Front, Hagiak sends you against the Gelkis clan’s Outcast scouts, marauders and necromancers. The Magram seek to claim Desolace for centaur of their own blood.

sections.title: Magram's Demand
sections.body: Hagiak at the Magram Front sends you toward the Gelkis village to the southwest. He expects you to prove your allegiance to the Magram by striking at the Gelkis Outcasts. The clan wants the land for centaur of Magram blood, and Hagiak's call leaves little room for doubt.

sections.title: A Claim to Desolace
sections.body: Hagiak's scouts report your success, and he says the Magram can continue their training in peace. He calls for any stragglers to be killed so they fear leaving their village. The Magram still mean to claim the Gelkis home and Desolace for themselves.

faq.answer: Hagiak, at the Magram Front, sends you against the Gelkis Outcasts.
Their village lies to the southwest of the Magram Front.
They are Gelkis scouts, marauders and necromancers.

faq.q: Why does Hagiak send me after them?
faq.answer: Hagiak expects you to prove your allegiance to the Magram by attacking the Gelkis Outcasts.
The Magram claim the Gelkis home and Desolace for centaur born of Magram blood.
